entries.definition: Pressure passes through a piece to attack a target behind it.

entries.name: x-ray-attack
entries.definition: Pressure that works through an intervening piece along a file, rank, or diagonal. If the front piece moves, the rear target is hit.

entries.name: Zugzwang
entries.definition: Any legal move worsens the player's position.

entries.name: Zwischenzug
entries.definition: An in-between move is played before the expected move.
